_comment: The one place a filter is defined. Python (site/build.py) reads it to build data/facets.json; the browser (site/lib/bench.js) reads it to draw the filter bar and to apply the URL state. Add a filter: add an entry here; every visual that lists its id in visual.json gets it. `column` is a data/scores.csv column; `labels` names a label map published in facets.json (see site/build.py LABELS).
